status: Frozen before first SNN training run; one architecture and one hyperparameter setting
scope: Post-declared conventional SNN reference on already examined v1 synthetic and frozen SST holdouts; exploratory comparison
architecture: Single-layer recurrent leaky integrate-and-fire, spike-only low-pass readout, linear classifier
reset: Soft subtractive reset by one threshold; reset spike is stop_gradient; no refractory period
integration: Exponential leak per supplied dt with frozen current; at most one spike per supplied time bin
input_encoding: Same real-valued current input plus log1p(dt); no input/membrane bypass to output
state_scalars: 3 * width: membrane, prior spike, filtered spike
selection: Minimum validation cross entropy at updates 50,100,150,200,250,300
synthetic_data: Exactly original v1 dataset_suite(task,seed), verified by recorded per-split fingerprints
frozen_corruption: Gaussian sigma 0.15 plus 20% local feature-block dropout, full-sentence global feature always retained; not raw missing input
claim_limit: Dense CPU simulation; no neuromorphic, energy, SOTA, LLM or multimodal superiority inference
